lock_line_endings: Only CRLF-to-LF checkout conversion is admitted; canonical SHA and Git blob must match.
scope: Complete locked Cargo inputs plus original registry archives and full public pinned Git source/modes/grants. Git Cargo.toml build manifests are Cargo-normalized; full original manifests remain under original-git. Installed compiler/linker/target, wasm-bindgen CLI, Node/Python/browser are prerequisites, not bundled. Original third-party grants apply; no global relicensing.
